summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 (Vault Migration) gap closure by removing dead migration code, then handle all PR review comments to get PR #344 merged.
summary.outcome: Phase 20 fully completed with 9/9 verification truths passing. PR #344 cleaned up across 4 rounds of review resolution (CodeRabbit + Copilot), including a critical fix to vault.rs init ordering, migration consolidation, and security fixes to recovery.html.

repo: v2 blob format is exclusively for the root vault blob (wraps rootFolderKey via ECIES). All non-root folder metadata continues to use v1 JSON format ({iv, data}). These are not interchangeable.
TypeORM auto-discovers migrations from the migrations/ directory glob — no explicit imports needed in migration configuration.
The API uses NestJS validation pipe with whitelist/forbidNonWhitelisted — sending extra properties (e.g. encryptedRootFolderKey) to simplified DTOs causes 400 errors.
Orval regenerates index.ts but does not delete orphaned model files — stale files must be removed manually after schema changes.
HKDF-derived ipnsName is always identical to stored rootIpnsName by construction — CodeRabbit flagged this repeatedly as a false positive.
The web client correctly publishes IPFS blob before API registration; the desktop Rust client had this ordering wrong (API call before IPFS upload) — a real atomicity bug.

code.finding: Critical ordering bug: /vault/init API call happened before IPFS upload + IPNS publish. If IPFS fails, backend has a vault row with no blob. Fixed by moving API registration to after successful IPFS upload.
deserializeVaultBlobV2 rejected zero-length keys but serializeVaultBlobV2 did not — asymmetric validation. Both directions now reject keyLen === 0.
All fetch() calls in IPFS resolution paths lacked AbortController timeouts. Added fetchWithTimeout helper with 15s/30s limits covering full response including body reads (no .finally() abort).
rootIpnsName flowed into innerHTML unsanitized. Fixed with format validation (^k[0-9a-z]{20,}$) and escapeHtml helper for exportedAt/derivationInfo fields.

FullSchema originally created vaults with encrypted_root_folder_key and encrypted_root_ipns_private_key as NOT NULL. Two subsequent migrations added migrated_at then dropped all three columns — net zero. Updated FullSchema to current schema and deleted both intermediary migrations.
Rust serialize path also lacked zero-length key validation — only deserialize rejected it. Both paths now validate.
Inline deserializeVaultBlobV2 in recovery.html was missing the zero-length key_len check that existed in the core package version.

workflow: GitHub outside-diff review comments (on lines not in the PR diff) appear only in the review body text, not as resolvable threads — they must be handled by reading the review body separately via the reviews API.
GSD gap closure mode (--gaps-only) skips research and reads VERIFICATION.md directly to generate targeted fix plans.
SDK E2E tests need updating whenever API DTOs change — they directly construct request bodies that must match the current DTO shape.
Spot-checking agent completion via SUMMARY.md existence + git log grep is reliable even when the Task() call itself reports a runtime error (classifyHandoffIfNeeded bug).

friction: GitHub CI job logs were not immediately available (job still in progress) — had to fetch via job ID directly rather than run logs.
Orval regenerated index.ts but left orphaned model files on disk, requiring manual cleanup after API client regeneration.
CodeRabbit flagged the HKDF-derived ipnsName === rootIpnsName pattern as a bug across multiple review rounds — required repeated not-applicable responses explaining the construction invariant.
The outside-diff critical comment in the CodeRabbit review was invisible to the normal thread-based resolution workflow and required reading the raw review body to discover.
vault.rs changes required checking Rust compilation manually since there are no unit tests for the init ordering path — had to rely on cargo build for validation.
open_items: 2 items flagged for human verification in live environment: new user init IPFS blob publish (before API registration) and recovery tool IPFS-direct path with real vault — requires live IPFS gateway.
Recovery tool key textareas still use type=text (pending final commit in transcript) — should be type=password to prevent shoulder surfing.
Phase 23 is next in the roadmap — discuss-phase/plan-phase not yet started.
